description: Per-emitter particle FX upgrade catalog for holtburger-web (?particleFx). One entry per retail ParticleEmitter (0x32) in client_portal.dat + every synthesized Visual-Behavior-Suite emitter. Generated by tools/particle-fx (DAT extraction + family/behaviour generator + per-family review); scripts/gen-particle-fx-profiles.mjs turns it into scene3d/particles/particle_fx_profiles.js.

families.flame_tongue: tall licking flame sprite (directional — never spun)
families.smoke_add: white wispy smoke/steam drawn additively (must not glow)
families.mist_white: soft white additive cloud (spray / breath / ghostly mist)
families.swirl_tex: full-frame swirl stripes (enchantment column body; square — never spun)
families.rune: glowing glyph / sigil (orientation matters — never spun)
families.misc: one-off picture sprite (faces, moons, signs, creatures) — left as authored
families.none: surface without a texture — nothing is drawn (left neutral)
families.sky: sky-chain object (moon nebula / celestial sheet) — the sky chain is excluded from FX at runtime
